_comment: Shape of the bulk file given to `npx wrangler secret bulk <file> --config admin/wrangler.jsonc`. Written outside the repository, deleted after the call. These values are placeholders; none of the public site's secrets belongs here. ENVIRONMENT, ADMIN_TIMEZONE and PUBLIC_SITE_URL are vars of the configuration, not secrets; ADMIN_OPERATORS is a secret so that no email address is committed.
ADMIN_OPERATORS: <comma-separated operator emails, the same list as the Access policy>
STRIPE_READ_KEY: <restricted key: Balance Transactions Read, Charges Read, PaymentIntents Read, Webhook Endpoints Read>
STRIPE_REFUND_KEY: <restricted key: Refunds Write, PaymentIntents Read; only when the plan has the refund control>
META_ADS_MANAGE_TOKEN: <system user token with ads_management; only when the plan has the ads controls>
TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID: <the chat the bot sends to; optional>
